title: Hardening S4: Golden-path workflows and one-shot closeout
description: Both audited agents used the manual 5-step closeout because the work was unreserved and closeout-work.md never prescribes gate closeout or agent finish in its steps. Rewrite workflows around the one-shot paths and close the unreserved-work gap. Depends on S1 (stable envelopes) and S2 (gate-scoped health).
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with commit checkpoints
Documented golden path closes a task in one bwrk command and a sprint in at most 4
